raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `--enable-deterministic-inference`, which promises batch-invariant ops, sampled speculative requests on B200 can get different tokens when the batch size changes.

On `openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B` with DSpark and `--random-seed 42`, row 0 gets token 19929 at batch 1 and 19930 at batch 8 and 32. Over 16 seed and prompt pairs, one differs between batch 1 and 8 on main and none with this change.

This keeps a contract and has no expected accuracy effect, because only rounding changes. EAGLE and NEXTN show token flips only on synthetic logits, so DSpark is the only server-visible symptom seen.

Under the flag, the sampler uses `torch.softmax`, but DSpark's `SoftmaxTemp` calls FlashInfer and four draft and verify calls use `sampling.softmax`. On B200, both select a launch configuration from the row count.

No open PR fixes this. #46657, #45894, #46211 and #47317 edit the same softmax code, so the later merge must keep the flag check.

## Modifications

Under the flag, `spec_softmax` uses `torch.softmax` for the four calls, and `SoftmaxTemp` uses its existing Triton branch. Other runs do not change.

DSpark avoids `torch.softmax` because its bits can change with row position at some vocabulary sizes, as measured on MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B at 248094, which is not a multiple of 4. Draft and verify keep it to match the sampler, so they share this limit.

## Accuracy Tests

These results are from before I squashed this branch onto main `7b88f09239`. The squash kept the same diff, and I did not repeat these runs on it. On the squashed commit, only pre-commit, `test_eagle_draft_sampling.py` and `test_graph_pool_borrow.py` ran, on CPU. Their only failure also occurs on main in that environment, and GPU-only cases skipped.

No accuracy eval ran with the flag on. On B200 (torch 2.14.1, FlashInfer 0.7.2), softmax rows compare a row in a batch with that row alone.

| Route or run | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `sampling.softmax` at 32000, temperature 0.7, 1 to 256 rows | Differs at 16-22, 129 and above. Seeded flips at 129 rows, with the hash and scoring of `fast_sample`, on main 582168dd7c and an earlier head with the same softmax behavior: 17 in 247,365,632 draws on synthetic `flat` logits, 4 in 246,054,912 on synthetic `lm` logits. |
| `sampling.softmax` at 128256 | Differs at 8-17, 32-33. Flips not run. |
| `sampling.softmax` at 154880 | Differs at 8-11, 15-17, 22 and above. Flips not run. |
| `sampling.softmax` at 248320 | Differs at 8-34, 36 and above. Seeded flips at 8 rows on synthetic `lm` logits: 0 in 41,566,208 draws (about 0.7 expected). |
| Replay of the first 5 `flat` flips and all 4 `lm` flips, 9 of the 21, through `sample_draft_proposal` | All 9 differed with deterministic inference off and matched with it on. |
| FlashInfer at 32000 and 130560 | Differs at 37 rows and above. |
| FlashInfer at 248094 | Differs at 2 rows and above. |
| `torch.softmax` at 32000, 128256, 130560, 154880 and 248320 | No difference. |
| `torch.softmax` at 248094 | Differs at odd positions on 18 to 38 of 64 synthetic inputs per shape at temperature 0.7. Flips not run. |
| Triton at 32000, 130560 and 248094 | No difference. |
| MiniCPM5-2B server: cookbook block size 7 (no B200 cell), target and draft `fa4`, `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill=disabled`, temperature 1.0, fresh server per batch size | With this change, row 0 gets token 19928 and the same 200 tokens at batch 1, 8 and 32. |
| MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B server, which needs open #41391 to start, with Triton attention and the default block size | `torch.softmax` gave different bits for 18 of 35 inputs seen at several positions, and this change for none. |
| Draft and verify regression test | Fails on main c8704818d4 with the flag on, and passes with this change. |
| DSpark regression test at 130560 and 248094 | Fails on main and with `torch.softmax`, and passes with this change. |
| `test_eagle_reject_sampling_deterministic` | One unique output across batch sizes 1 to 6. |
| `test_spec_eagle` | No failure found. |
| `test_eagle_reject_sampling` (`sglang.test.run_eval` GSM8K, 200 examples), flag off, so both trees take the same softmax route | 0.900 against 0.905 on main. |
| CPU suite on main 99fd01047d merged with both changes and other PRs | Failed only in files that also fail on main, plus `test_kv_events` with `Address already in use`, a flake also seen on main. |

The two changes touch different files. GPU tests ran on each change separately, not on the combined tree.

Not fixed: sampled DSpark ignores `sampling_seed`, the sampler keeps that limit, and top-k or top-p target probabilities keep `torch.softmax`, untested for position dependence.

Not checked: SM103, ROCm, other Blackwell parts, Hopper, NPU, Sail, verify-side flips, a draft or verify flip reaching server output, `test_multi_layer_eagle_reject_sampling_deterministic`, DeepSeek-V4 (the flag refuses `dsv4`), and full CI.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Under the flag, draft and verify lose the #47512 gain on SM100 (not measured), and DSpark takes 0.27 ms instead of 0.15 ms per call at vocabulary 130560 and 448 rows.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No change is needed for this fix.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Accuracy is covered above. Speed was measured only for DSpark.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+"""DSpark's accept softmax must not depend on the batch under deterministic inference."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark.dspark_accept import SoftmaxTemp
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=20, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+# On B200, FlashInfer gives a row different bits at 37 rows and above at 130560
+# (MiniCPM5-2B). torch.softmax gives some rows different bits at odd positions at 248094
+# (MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B), so a request needs an odd row count to start at an odd position.
+VOCABS = (130560, 248094)
+BATCH_SIZE = 8
+ROWS_PER_REQUEST = 7
+
+
+class TestDSparkSoftmaxDeterministic(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_request_gets_same_bits_in_any_batch(self):
+        generator = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(0)
+        temperatures = torch.full((BATCH_SIZE,), 0.7, device=DEVICE)
+
+        def softmax(logits):
+            return SoftmaxTemp.execute(
+                logits=logits,
+                temperatures=temperatures[: logits.shape[0] // ROWS_PER_REQUEST],
+                rows_per_request=ROWS_PER_REQUEST,
+            )
+
+        for vocab in VOCABS:
+            logits = torch.randn(
+                (BATCH_SIZE * ROWS_PER_REQUEST, vocab),
+                device=DEVICE,
+                generator=generator,
+            )
+            with get_context().override_server_args(
+                enable_deterministic_inference=True
+            ):
+                batch = softmax(logits).split(ROWS_PER_REQUEST)
+                for slot, request in enumerate(logits.split(ROWS_PER_REQUEST)):
+                    self.assertTrue(
+                        torch.equal(batch[slot], softmax(request.clone())),
+                        f"vocab {vocab}, slot {slot}",
+                    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+                scaled,
+            ),
